scope: Post-open mechanism-capacity diagnostic on the already opened BLASTNet Case 5 and Case 2 development conditions. It is not a deployable selector, fresh external validation, resource result, curved-ray result, or real-BOST result.
scientific_question: Can the already validated deployment-visible Low-64 harmonic observability scalar strictly separate every cell where direct Low64-PCGLS K11 is safe from every cell where it is unsafe relative to the adequate Zero-PCGLS K16 reference, or does the observable row-space transfer harm overlap in this scalar?

frozen_parent_evidence.v214_role: The harmonic-observability formula and high-is-safer orientation are inherited without modification from the independently validated v214 observation-only spectral proxy.
frozen_parent_evidence.v221_role: Formal and independently recomputed direct Low64-PCGLS K11 and Zero-PCGLS K16 metrics provide the post-open safety labels.
frozen_parent_evidence.v222_1_role: The independently validated algebraic attribution establishes that null(A) removal preserves Case5 benefit and Case2 harm, motivating a row-space spectral diagnostic.

deployment_visible_primary.name: low64_harmonic_observability
deployment_visible_primary.low64_proxy: Use the frozen unregularized Moore-Penrose coefficients c_hat from M and y.
deployment_visible_primary.scalar: h=||c_hat||^2 / sum_i((v_i^T c_hat)^2/max(lambda_i,64*float64_epsilon)), where G=V diag(lambda) V^T.
deployment_visible_primary.orientation: Higher h is safer; this orientation is frozen from v214 and may not be reversed after results.

cheap_control.name: low64_observable_fit_residual
cheap_control.role: If q0 alone passes the same strict separation and selected-policy gates, it explains any primary headroom at lower conceptual complexity.

truth_visible_capacity_labels.safe_cell: All four direct metrics satisfy the frozen strict absolute limits and direct/reference ratios are <=1.05.
truth_visible_capacity_labels.truth_role: Truth and reference metrics are used only to evaluate scalar capacity after both scalar arrays are sealed; they are forbidden from scalar construction.

strict_separation_gate.primary_margin: min(h over safe cells)-max(h over unsafe cells) must be strictly positive.
strict_separation_gate.control_margin: min(q0 over unsafe cells)-max(q0 over safe cells) must be strictly positive.
strict_separation_gate.threshold_if_positive: Arithmetic midpoint of the two boundary values; equality follows the frozen safer-side rule.

selected_policy_gate.policy: Use direct Low64-PCGLS K11 when the scalar accepts; otherwise restart the adequate Zero-PCGLS K16 reference.

independent_validation.formal: QR Low-64 basis, direct SVD proxy, and direct eigendecomposition of the normalized Gram.
independent_validation.independent: SVD Low-64 span, normal-eigensystem proxy, independently rebuilt reported rigs, independent labels from the sealed v221 validator, and independent recomputation of both strict separators, selected metrics, rig tails, and call ledgers.

decision_order: Any parent/input/source drift, non-finite value, rank loss, camera-permutation failure, missing cell, formal-independent mismatch, or label mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_LOW64_HARMONIC_RISK_V223.
If the primary margin is not strictly positive, conclude FAIL_LOW64_HARMONIC_RISK_OVERLAP_V223 and close this scalar risk gate.
If the primary separates but the selected policy fails any full accuracy or cost gate, conclude FAIL_LOW64_HARMONIC_RISK_POLICY_V223.
If the primary passes and the cheap q0 control also passes, conclude PASS_LOW64_HARMONIC_RISK_BUT_FIT_RESIDUAL_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_V223 and do not claim a distinct harmonic mechanism.

Only if the primary separates, the selected policy passes, and q0 does not pass may the result be called PASS_LOW64_HARMONIC_RISK_DEVELOPMENT_HEADROOM_V223. This authorizes only a separately frozen observation-only selector test.
stop_rule: A failed or inconclusive v223 closes this one-dimensional harmonic-risk route. Do not tune the orientation, threshold, Low-64 rank, basis, residual definition, solver depth, or add a larger model to rescue it.
